texto.es: Nos dices que necesita tu jardin: corte regular, limpieza puntual o control de plagas. Respondemos al (954) 665-9913.
texto.en: Tell us what your yard needs: regular mowing, a one time cleanup, or pest control. We answer at (954) 665-9913.

texto.es: Revisamos el area y te damos el costo antes de empezar, segun el tamano y su estado.
texto.en: We look at the area and give you the cost before we start, based on the size and its condition.

texto.es: Corte, borde y limpieza en un horario constante, cesped tras cesped.
texto.en: Mowing, edging and cleanup on a steady schedule, lawn after lawn.

titulo.en: A yard that stays on top

texto.es: Tu cesped se mantiene parejo visita tras visita, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: Your lawn stays even and consistent visit after visit, no surprises.

nota.es: Cada servicio se cotiza segun el tamano del jardin y su estado. Llama y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every service is quoted based on the size of the yard and its condition. Call and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Corte regular con patron parejo, borde de caminos y calles para un frente siempre cuidado.
texto.en: Regular mowing with an even stripe pattern, edging along walkways and curbs for a yard that always looks kept.

texto.es: Recorte de arbustos, poda ligera y limpieza de hojas y ramas caidas.
texto.en: Shrub trimming, light pruning and removal of fallen leaves and branches.

texto.es: Tratamiento de plagas comunes del jardin y la casa, con seguimiento segun necesidad.
texto.en: Treatment for common yard and household pests, with follow up as needed.

texto.es: Revision del estado del cesped y recomendaciones para mantenerlo verde durante todo el ano.
texto.en: Lawn health checks and recommendations to keep it green all year round.

pie.es: Necesitas algo puntual, como una limpieza antes de una visita? Tambien lo hacemos, pregunta.
pie.en: Need something one time, like a cleanup before a visit? We do that too, just ask.
